title: The Cutting Edge: Week of July 12th
body:
**Highlights**
- The [AMA with Justin Murphy](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1415053627610202112?s=20) for the community-funded project ‘Exit Theory’ got an enormous response. The event concluded with surprises for the Edgeware Community in the form of IndieThinkers.org Pro memberships’ and Urbit Planets' drops.
- Biconomy unlocked [next-gen essentials for Edgeware mainnet's EVM environment](https://blog.edgewa.re/biconomy/) utilizing their industry-leading meta-transaction infrastructure.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [latest release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.3.3) to proceed further with the ERUP-4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance.
- Community members who are interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members who are interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
No governance activity was in the pipeline for the week. 

**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in,[ take a look.](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal)
- Trending Community Research thread(s):
- [Proposal: Ecosystem Partner Grant Structure](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1435-proposal-ecosystem-partner-grant-structure)


**Events**
- The Edgeware All-Community call was hosted on July 14, 2021. Each month, different individuals/entities from the agency, builder guild, different working groups and enthusiasts come together to speak on various essential topics, ideas and updates related to Edgeware. If you missed it, you can find the[ meeting notes with recordings here](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/p
